options: Max vowel frequency and max consonant frequency; counts only increase

cards.answer: Max vowel frequency and max consonant frequency; counts only increase
cards.explanation: Counts never decrease, so the maximum after each increment is the true maximum so far.

promptVariants: Why can both maxima be computed in the same pass as the counting?
What if there is no vowel or no consonant?
cards.answer: Only the letter whose count just increased can become the new maximum of its category, so comparing that count with the running maximum is enough. If a category is absent its maximum stays 0, contributing nothing to the sum.

cards.answer: 2 (each vowel appears twice, no consonant), and 1
cards.explanation: The most frequent vowel appears twice and there is no consonant, so the sum is 2. In 'xyz' every consonant appears once, so the maximum is 1 and there are no vowels.
